title: 弗雷瑞斯公路隧道~Frejus Road Tunnel
focus: 新舊孔切換、重車服務與維護隔離~Old-new bore transfer, freight service and maintenance isolation
summary: 法國交通主管機關列弗雷瑞斯原隧道12.87公里、1980年營運，並於2025年公告第二孔開通活動。本課不把原始單孔狀態當成永久現況，而以新舊孔轉換為主軸，研究重車交通、岩體、通風隔離、跨孔救援與設備版本，建立分階段可驗證的營運模型。~The French transport ministry records the original Frejus tunnel as 12.87 km, in service from 1980, and announced the second-tube opening event in 2025. The course does not treat the original single-bore arrangement as permanent. It studies staged transfer, freight traffic, rock behaviour, airflow isolation, cross-bore rescue and equipment revisions.

units.anchor: 路線里程與端點~Alignment chainage and endpoints
units.title: 服務邊界與路線代價~Service boundaries and alignment cost
units.mechanism: 弗雷瑞斯由原孔到第二孔的配置變化需先定義階段，教材把道路容量、救援通道和施工空間分開。隧道選線同時改變洞口、覆土與縱坡，短路線不保證低地質風險。比較方案必須使用相同起訖點，並分開主孔、引道及服務坑的工程數量；交通時間只是需求的一個指標，不能代替施工可達性或長期維修評估。~Define configuration stages before comparing the original and second tubes, separating road capacity, rescue access and construction space. Alignment changes portals, cover and gradient together, so a shorter tunnel need not have lower geological risk. Compare options between identical endpoints and distinguish running bores, approaches and service galleries. Travel time measures one service benefit but cannot replace assessment of construction access, maintenance closures or exposure to uncertain ground.
units.model: 原創教學假設：長度=17.6 km；速度=60 km/h。t=60L/v=17.6 min。僅把長度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為19.36 min。邊界：假想交通旅程，未含加減速、排隊及實際時刻表；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: length=17.6 km; speed=60 km/h. t=60L/v=17.6 min. Increasing only length by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 19.36 min. Boundary: Hypothetical transport journey excluding acceleration, queues and the real timetable. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。把縱斷面、地形與地質剖面疊合，以端點坐標獨立反算距離，再將主孔與支坑數量分開核對。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams. Overlay the longitudinal profile, terrain and geology; independently derive distances from endpoint coordinates and reconcile running-bore and gallery quantities separately. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 把舊單孔描述用於新配置會錯估對向衝突及逃生路線。混用全線與單孔長度會同時扭曲工程數量、行程及逃生距離，造成方案比較失去共同基準。~Applying an old single-bore description misstates opposing traffic and escape routes. Mixing whole-route and single-bore lengths distorts quantities, journey time and escape distance, destroying the common basis of an option comparison.
units.misconception: 最短的隧道路線一定也有最低施工與維護風險。~The shortest tunnel alignment necessarily has the lowest construction and maintenance risk.
units.practice: 本案「路線里程與端點」的交付需回答：每個方案附日期和孔別，不混用不同時期示意圖。在方案表中凍結起訖點、計量範圍及地質假設，任何改線都要同步更新高程、數量與服務情境，不能只替換總長。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the alignment chainage and endpoints handover must address the following evidence: Attach dates and bore identifiers to each option and avoid mixing historical diagrams. Freeze endpoints, measurement scope and ground assumptions in the option register; realignment requires coordinated updates to elevations, quantities and service scenarios rather than replacing one length.

units.title: 破碎帶連通與預報更新~Fault connectivity and forecast updating
units.mechanism: 平行第二孔可利用原孔資料但不能省略新探查，弗雷瑞斯教材研究斜交節理在兩孔位置的差異。斷層帶可以含很硬的岩塊，但整體變形與湧水常由填充節理和連通裂隙控制。單一岩芯強度不能代表整個掌子面；超前鑽孔、出水變化與揭露地質須回饋同一里程模型，預報則應保留不同情境及其證據權重。~The second tube can use first-bore records without replacing new investigation; examine oblique joints crossing each bore at different positions. A fault zone may contain strong intact blocks while filled joints and connected fractures govern its bulk deformation and inflow. One core strength does not represent the entire face. Probe records, water response and exposed geology must update a common chainage model, preserving competing interpretations and their evidential weight rather than treating a forecast as certainty.
units.model: 原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=340 m²。Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.003927 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=340 m². Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.003927 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 將構造方位投影到兩孔里程，再用新揭露驗證。將岩心回收、裂隙方位與出水曲線按里程對齊，用未參與建模的孔段作交叉檢驗，檢查是否只擬合已知資料。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Project structural orientation onto both chainages and test against new exposures. Align recovery, fracture orientation and inflow by chainage; test the interpretation against a withheld borehole interval to detect fitting only the known observations. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 按相同里程直接配對地質會忽略斜交造成的位置差。只用完整岩石強度會漏掉軟弱填充物，可能在看似堅硬的地層中出現收斂加快、支護過載或水量突增。~Matching geology at equal chainage ignores offsets caused by oblique structures. Intact strength alone misses weak infill, allowing accelerating convergence, support overload or sudden inflow in ground that superficially appears strong.
units.misconception: 岩芯很硬就可以排除破碎帶變形與集中湧水。~Hard intact core excludes fault-zone deformation and concentrated inflow.
units.practice: 本案「破碎帶連通性」的交付需回答：將構造方位投影到兩孔里程，再用新揭露驗證。每次地質模型更新保留舊版與新增證據，差異由地質及支護設計者共同判讀，施工條件改變需重新確認核准範圍。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the fault-zone connectivity handover must address the following evidence: Project structural orientation onto both chainages and test against new exposures. Retain previous interpretations and new evidence at every update; geology and support designers jointly interpret differences and reconfirm approved bounds when ground conditions change.

units.anchor: 洞壁切向應力~Tangential wall stress
units.title: 覆土應力與洞壁重分配~Cover stress and wall redistribution
units.mechanism: 第二孔開挖與原孔營運並存時需檢查岩柱應力重分配，單孔覆土估算只是起點。開挖使岩體洞壁失去徑向拘束，遠場荷載轉移到周圍岩體，局部切向應力可能升高。圓孔彈性解可辨識量級，但節理、非圓斷面、塑性區與原位應力比會改變峰值位置，不能只用覆土重量推定全部三維應力。~When excavation coexists with first-bore operation, examine pillar stress redistribution beyond a single-hole cover estimate. Excavation removes radial confinement at the wall and transfers load through the surrounding rock, potentially raising local tangential stress. An elastic circular-hole solution identifies scale, but joints, noncircular geometry, yielding and the in-situ stress ratio alter the peak location. Cover weight alone cannot establish the complete three-dimensional stress state or support demand.
units.model: 原創教學假設：覆土深度=920 m；岩體單位重=26 kN/m³。σθ,max=3γH/1000=71.76 MPa。僅把覆土深度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為78.936 MPa。邊界：無支承彈性圓孔，僅垂直遠場壓縮且水平遠場應力為零時，側壁最大環向壓應力；不是任意位置應力或完整三維原位解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: cover=920 m; rock unit weight=26 kN/m³. σθ,max=3γH/1000=71.76 MPa. Increasing only cover by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 78.936 MPa. Boundary: Maximum tangential compression at the sidewalls of an unsupported elastic circular hole under vertical uniaxial remote loading with zero horizontal remote stress; not stress at any point or the complete three-dimensional in-situ state. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。將原位應力量測、岩石試驗及洞壁破壞方位相互比較，再用多點伸長計檢查變形是否與所假設應力方向一致。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Align old-bore movement with new-face distance while excluding thermal drift. Compare in-situ stress measurements, rock tests and wall-damage orientation, then use multipoint extensometers to test consistency with the assumed stress directions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 未扣溫度的位移可能被誤判成新孔造成的地盤作用。把彈性峰值直接當岩體強度可能誤判支護需求；相反地忽略剝落或擠壓也會讓局部破壞逐步侵入淨空。~Uncorrected thermal movement can be misattributed to excavation interaction. Equating an elastic peak with rock-mass strength misjudges support demand; overlooking spalling or squeezing lets damage progressively consume clearance.
units.misconception: 知道覆土深度就能唯一決定洞壁各方向的應力。~Cover depth uniquely determines wall stress in every direction.
units.practice: 本案「洞壁切向應力」的交付需回答：把原孔位移與新掌子面距離對齊，排除溫度漂移。保留應力模型的座標、邊界和材料假設，量測與預測不符時先核對代表性，再由岩力設計者選擇非線性或節理模型。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the tangential wall stress handover must address the following evidence: Align old-bore movement with new-face distance while excluding thermal drift. Record stress-model coordinates, boundaries and material assumptions; when observations disagree, check representativeness before the rock designer selects nonlinear or jointed models.

units.anchor: 支護安裝時點~Support activation time
units.title: 支護啟動與變形容量~Support activation and deformation capacity
units.mechanism: 弗雷瑞斯新舊支護設計背景不同，教材比較荷載啟動時點及長期劣化，不只比較材料強度。支護荷載由開挖釋放量和支護啟動時間共同決定，越早安裝不一定讓構件受力越小。地盤反力與支護曲線必須連同掌子面距離及封閉順序理解；擠壓性地層還需保留變形容量，不能只追求高剛度與高材料強度。~New and old support have different histories; compare activation time and ageing rather than material strength alone. Support load depends on stress release and activation time, so earlier installation does not necessarily reduce member forces. Interpret ground-reaction and support curves together with distance from the face and closure sequence. Squeezing ground also needs deformation capacity; high stiffness and material strength alone do not guarantee a compatible support response.
units.model: 原創教學假設：局部剛度=44 kN/mm；位移=8 mm。F=ku=352 kN。僅把位移增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為387.2 kN。邊界：線性局部彈簧，不含屈服或時間效應；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: local stiffness=44 kN/mm; movement=8 mm. F=ku=352 kN. Increasing only movement by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 387.2 kN. Boundary: Local linear spring without yielding or time effects. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 分別建立新支護荷重與舊支護檢查的時間基準。同步記錄收斂、支護荷重與安裝里程，比較同一地質分區內的速率及荷載，不將不同開挖齡期讀值直接混合。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Maintain separate time references for new support loads and legacy inspections. Synchronise convergence, support loads and installation chainage; compare rates and loads within one ground domain without mixing readings at different excavation ages. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 新支護較強不能證明舊孔整修可省略施工階段分析。過晚封閉會讓不可回復變形增加，過硬且行程不足的支護也可能脆裂，兩者都可能表現為裂縫而需不同處理。~Stronger new support does not remove staging analysis for old-bore refurbishment. Late closure increases irreversible movement, while excessively stiff support with little travel can fail brittly; both produce cracks but require different diagnoses.
units.misconception: 支護越厚越硬就一定能解決所有擠壓性地層。~Thicker and stiffer support necessarily solves every squeezing-ground problem.
units.practice: 本案「支護安裝時點」的交付需回答：分別建立新支護荷重與舊支護檢查的時間基準。把安裝時間和量測資料一起交付支護設計者，任何級別變更都需地質及位移證據，不能憑單一瞬間讀值自行改支護。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the support activation time handover must address the following evidence: Maintain separate time references for new support loads and legacy inspections. Submit installation times with measurements to the support designer; class changes need both ground and movement evidence, not an isolated instantaneous reading.

units.anchor: 襯砌環向壓縮~Lining hoop compression
units.title: 環向受力與接縫柔度~Ring force and joint flexibility
units.mechanism: 重車公路的襯砌和設備支承有不同作用，教材用均勻外壓示例後再辨識附掛設備局部荷載。圓形襯砌對均勻外壓可主要以環向壓縮抵抗，但接頭轉動、偏壓與背填空隙會引起彎矩。薄環膜應力只說明其中一條受力路徑；脫模、運輸、頂推及永久狀態的荷載不同，環片局部接觸與止水條件必須另外檢核。~Lining and equipment supports carry different actions; follow a uniform-pressure example with identification of local suspended loads. A circular lining resists uniform external pressure largely through hoop compression, but joint rotation, uneven load and backfill voids generate bending. Thin-ring membrane stress describes only one load path. Demoulding, transport, jacking and permanent states impose different actions, requiring separate checks of local segment contact and sealing rather than one permanent-load calculation.
units.model: 原創教學假設：均勻外壓=0.58 MPa；半徑=3.4 m；厚度=0.35 m。σθ=pr/t=5.63429 MPa。僅把均勻外壓增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為6.19771 MPa。邊界：薄圓環膜應力，不是接縫、偏壓或矩形框架解；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: uniform external pressure=0.58 MPa; radius=3.4 m; thickness=0.35 m. σθ=pr/t=5.63429 MPa. Increasing only uniform external pressure by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 6.19771 MPa. Boundary: Thin circular-ring membrane stress, not a joint, uneven-load or rectangular-frame solution. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 核對設備錨固位置、裂縫圖及襯砌實際厚度。將環形變形、接縫張開與應變和含接頭彈簧的模型比較，分開安裝後、背填後及水頭回升後的基準。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check equipment anchorage, crack maps and actual lining thickness. Compare ring distortion, joint opening and strain with a joint-spring model, separating baselines after installation, grouting and head recovery. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 新增設備未回查襯砌狀態可能把局部負擔集中在弱區。局部脫空增加環片彎曲，裂縫未必代表混凝土平均強度不足；忽略接縫接觸會把補強方向導向錯誤位置。~New equipment without lining-condition checks can concentrate load in weak zones. Local voids increase bending, so cracks need not indicate inadequate mean concrete strength; neglecting joint contact can misdirect strengthening.
units.misconception: 混凝土強度達標就不必檢查接縫轉動與偏壓。~Passing concrete strength eliminates the need to check joint rotation and uneven pressure.
units.practice: 本案「襯砌環向壓縮」的交付需回答：核對設備錨固位置、裂縫圖及襯砌實際厚度。設計圖應分開標註各施工階段、接頭剛度及背填條件，構件驗收同時核對幾何、材料批次與止水試驗適用包絡。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the lining hoop compression handover must address the following evidence: Check equipment anchorage, crack maps and actual lining thickness. Drawings distinguish stages, joint stiffness and backfill conditions; component acceptance reconciles geometry, material batches and the applicable sealing-test envelope.

units.anchor: 風道摩擦壓損~Duct friction loss
units.title: 通風網路與壓力損失~Ventilation network and pressure loss
units.mechanism: 分向孔與原雙向情境的車流助風不同，弗雷瑞斯教材要求換孔後重新核對通風邊界。風機提供壓差，實際風量由風道摩阻、局部損失、外風與其他風機共同決定。支路開關會重新分配整個網路，不能把額定風量直接加總；正常污染稀釋與火災控煙也有不同目標，需要分別建立受控邊界和故障情境。~Directional tubes differ from former bidirectional traffic in piston effects; recheck airflow boundaries after configuration changes. Fans supply pressure, but actual flow follows friction, local losses, external wind and interactions with other fans. Switching a branch redistributes the network rather than simply adding rated flows. Routine dilution and fire smoke control have different objectives, so each needs explicit boundaries, operating states and failure cases rather than one universal flow target.
units.model: 原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1060 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.6937 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為58.9194 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1060 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.6937 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 58.9194 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 對比切換前後同風機設定的實測壓差和流量。沿線同步量測靜壓與風速，記錄風門及其他風機狀態，再把實測工作點和風機曲線、網路壓損比較。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare measured pressure and flow at equal fan settings before and after transfer. Measure pressure and velocity synchronously, record dampers and other fans, and compare the measured duty point with fan curves and network resistance. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 沿用舊控制參數可能在新車流方向下產生不符預期風向。只看風機轉速會漏掉風門誤位或短路漏風，可能在總耗電增加時，真正需要的區段反而風量不足。~Old controls may produce unintended airflow under the new traffic direction. Fan speed alone misses a misplaced damper or leakage shortcut; total power may rise while the critical section receives less air.
units.misconception: 風機銘牌風量相加就是全隧道各處可用的通風量。~Adding fan nameplate flows gives the usable airflow everywhere in the tunnel.
units.practice: 本案「風道摩擦壓損」的交付需回答：對比切換前後同風機設定的實測壓差和流量。驗收採明確風門和車流邊界，維修改線後重新核對網路工作點，火災模式由防災責任工程師簽認而非沿用正常模式。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the duct friction loss handover must address the following evidence: Compare measured pressure and flow at equal fan settings before and after transfer. Commission with specified damper and traffic boundaries, recheck duty points after rerouting, and have the fire-safety engineer approve emergency modes independently.

units.title: 視覺適應與路面亮度~Visual adaptation and pavement luminance
units.mechanism: 新舊孔表面與燈具狀態不同，教學比較相同照度下路面反射造成的亮度差。駕駛從洞外進入洞內時視覺適應需要時間，照度並不等同從駕駛視角看到的亮度。路面反射、濕度、燈具配光及背景對比共同影響辨識；朗伯模型只示範理想漫反射，不能直接制定入口段燈具間距或真實道路安全值。~Different surfaces and luminaires in old and new tubes can produce different luminance at equal illuminance. Driver adaptation takes time when entering a tunnel, and illuminance is not the luminance seen from the driving position. Pavement reflection, wetness, luminaire distribution and background contrast affect detection. A Lambertian model illustrates ideal diffuse reflection only; it cannot establish entrance-zone spacing or actual road-safety limits without photometric and operational assessment.
units.model: 原創教學假設：照度=108 lx；反射率=0.26 無因次。L=ρE/π=8.93814 cd/m²。僅把照度增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為9.83196 cd/m²。邊界：理想朗伯漫反射，不是真實濕路面亮度；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: illuminance=108 lx; reflectance=0.26 dimensionless. L=ρE/π=8.93814 cd/m². Increasing only illuminance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 9.83196 cd/m². Boundary: Ideal Lambertian reflection, not actual wet-road luminance. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 以同視角和乾濕條件比較兩孔的光度量測。以駕駛視角的亮度量測配合照度網格，分別檢查乾濕路面與燈具衰減，保留外部天空條件。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Compare photometry in both tubes under equal viewing and wetness conditions. Combine driver-view luminance with illuminance grids, checking dry and wet pavement and lamp depreciation while preserving exterior sky conditions. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 以新孔量測代表舊孔會低估老化表面與燈具影響。照度平均值合格仍可能存在低亮度障礙區或眩光，感測器沾污也會使調光系統低估外界亮度。~New-tube measurements do not represent aged surfaces and lamps in the old tube. Acceptable average illuminance can coexist with dark obstacles or glare, while sensor contamination may bias adaptive lighting controls.
units.misconception: 照度越高就必然使隧道內所有物體更容易辨識。~Higher illuminance necessarily makes every tunnel object easier to detect.
units.practice: 本案「漫反射亮度」的交付需回答：以同視角和乾濕條件比較兩孔的光度量測。將視角、路面狀態和光度校正連同量測交付，照明調整需按核准場景測試，不把理想反射公式當驗收標準。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the diffuse luminance handover must address the following evidence: Compare photometry in both tubes under equal viewing and wetness conditions. Hand over viewing geometry, pavement state and photometric calibration; test changes against approved scenarios rather than treating ideal reflection as an acceptance criterion.

units.anchor: 所需疏散時間~Required evacuation time
units.title: 疏散時間與分區可用性~Evacuation time and zone availability
units.mechanism: 跨孔撤離先確認鄰孔交通已處於受控狀態，教材將橫通道距離與安全孔可用性分開。疏散時間包含辨識、反應、移動及排隊，不只由出口距離決定。人員速度會受煙熱、能見度及行動能力影響，安全判斷還要比較可用安全時間；橫通道存在但門或鄰孔不可用時，圖上的最短路線不一定能作實際選擇。~Cross-bore evacuation first requires a controlled receiving tube; separate passage distance from receiving-bore availability. Evacuation includes detection, response, travel and queues, not merely distance to an exit. Smoke, visibility and mobility alter walking speed, while safety requires comparison with available safe time. A passage shown on a plan may be unusable because its door or receiving bore is unavailable, invalidating the nominal shortest route.
units.model: 原創教學假設：前置時間=108 s；行走距離=340 m；行走速度=0.8 m/s。RSET=tpre+d/v=533 s。僅把行走距離增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為575.5 s。邊界：單群體固定速度，不含排隊煙熱及能力差異，不能單獨判安全；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: pre-movement time=108 s; travel distance=340 m; walking speed=0.8 m/s. RSET=tpre+d/v=533 s. Increasing only travel distance by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 575.5 s. Boundary: One group at fixed speed without queues, smoke or mobility differences; not a safety conclusion. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 演練同步核對交通隔離、門位和人員到達時間。以人流模擬或受控演練分辨前置時間、行走與門口排隊，核對每個出口接收區的可用狀態及通訊紀錄。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Exercise traffic isolation, door state and arrival timing together. Separate pre-movement, travel and doorway queues through simulation or controlled drills, checking receiving-zone availability and communication records for each exit. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 橫通道到達快不代表鄰孔車流已安全停止。以最快成人速度套全部旅客會低估需求，若忽略接收孔受煙或車流影響，疏散可能移到另一個危險邊界。~Fast passage arrival does not establish stopped traffic in the receiving bore. Applying the fastest adult speed to everyone understates demand; overlooking smoke or traffic in the receiving bore can transfer evacuees into another hazard.
units.misconception: 只要出口距離短，就不需要比較可用與所需安全時間。~Short exit distance removes the need to compare available and required safe time.
units.practice: 本案「所需疏散時間」的交付需回答：演練同步核對交通隔離、門位和人員到達時間。疏散模型保留人口、速度分布及出口狀態，演練改動由營運與防災責任者批准，教材算例不得當作現場指揮程序。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the required evacuation time handover must address the following evidence: Exercise traffic isolation, door state and arrival timing together. Retain population, speed distribution and exit states; operations and fire-safety owners approve drill changes, and classroom calculations are not incident-command procedures.

units.title: 設備備援與共同失效~Equipment redundancy and common failure
units.mechanism: 兩孔控制若共享通訊骨幹，表面設備成雙仍可能共同失效，研究切換與隔離的測試範圍。兩套設備只有在故障近似獨立且切換可靠時，並聯才顯著降低不可用率。共用配電、控制軟體、冷卻或受淹位置會把獨立假設破壞；維修停用也改變當下配置，因此可靠度模型必須明列共有資源和設備狀態，不能只數備用台數。~Shared communications can defeat apparent twin-bore redundancy; examine the scope of transfer and isolation tests. Parallel equipment sharply reduces unavailability only when failures are approximately independent and transfer works. Shared power, software, cooling or flood exposure breaks that assumption. Planned maintenance also changes the available configuration, so reliability models must identify shared resources and states rather than count spare units or multiply unsupported independent probabilities.
units.model: 原創教學假設：單機不可用率=0.024 無因次。Uparallel=U²=0.000576 probability。僅把單機不可用率增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.00069696 probability。邊界：完全獨立並聯與完美切換，不含共同失效；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: single-unit unavailability=0.024 dimensionless. Uparallel=U²=0.000576 probability. Increasing only single-unit unavailability by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.00069696 probability. Boundary: Independent parallel units with perfect transfer, excluding common failures. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 追查兩孔感測、控制和供電的共同節點。由設備清單畫出故障樹，將電源、控制及實體位置追到共同節點，並用事件及維修紀錄檢查獨立假設。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Trace shared sensing, control and power nodes across both bores. Build a fault tree from the asset list, trace power, control and location to shared nodes, and test independence against incident and maintenance records. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 只測單台停機不能揭露骨幹失效造成的雙孔影響。重複安裝卻共用單一供電可能在一次故障中全部停機，帳面可靠度很高但實際不可用時間沒有降低。~Single-unit outage tests miss shared-backbone failure affecting both tubes. Duplicated equipment on one supply can fail together in a single event, leaving actual downtime unchanged despite optimistic calculated reliability.
units.misconception: 設備有兩台就可以直接把各自故障率相乘判定安全。~Two units allow their failure probabilities to be multiplied directly to establish safety.
units.practice: 本案「系統不可用率」的交付需回答：追查兩孔感測、控制和供電的共同節點。維修計畫附當日可用配置與剩餘備援，任何共同資源更動同步更新故障樹，切換試驗由設備及營運團隊共同見證。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the system unavailability handover must address the following evidence: Trace shared sensing, control and power nodes across both bores. Attach the actual configuration and remaining redundancy to maintenance plans, update fault trees after shared-resource changes, and witness transfer tests jointly.

units.title: 資產編碼與可追溯交接~Asset identity and traceable handover
units.mechanism: 弗雷瑞斯版本交付應保留原孔和新孔獨立設備樹，避免複製名稱後遺失安裝日期及測試狀態。地下設備的竣工資料必須讓維護人員找到正確位置、材料批次和控制版本。只有上傳圖面而沒有變更歷程，無法分辨元件替換與真正劣化；告警、儀器、線路及工單使用一致識別碼，才可能把量測趨勢連回實際受力或水力系統。~Maintain separate asset trees for old and new tubes, preserving installation dates and test states when names are copied. Handover must let maintainers find the correct location, material batch and control revision. Drawings without change history cannot distinguish replacement from deterioration. Consistent identifiers across alarms, instruments, circuits and work orders are essential for linking trends to the physical structural or hydraulic system instead of treating each record as an isolated file.
units.model: 原創教學假設：設備總數=114 個；缺紀錄數=16 個。coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.9649 %。僅把缺紀錄數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為84.5614 %。邊界：資料完整度，不等於安全或可靠度；擾動為連續敏感度，實際個數為整數；不是本工程實測或允收值。~Original teaching assumptions: asset count=114 count; missing records=16 count. coverage=100(N−missing)/N=85.9649 %. Increasing only missing records by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 84.5614 %. Boundary: Record completeness, not safety or reliability; perturbation is continuous sensitivity while actual counts are integers. These are not project measurements or acceptance values.
units.verify: 抽查同名設備是否有唯一孔別、位置和維護週期。抽取一條告警，從控制畫面追到設備、線路、圖面和工單，核對位置、版本及校正日期並記錄無法閉合的欄位。比對時保留校正、時間與基準版本，允收採設計核准條件。~Check similarly named assets have unique bore, location and maintenance interval. Trace a sampled alarm from screen to equipment, circuit, drawing and work order, checking location, revision and calibration dates and recording broken links. Retain calibration, timing and datum revisions, and compare against design-approved conditions.
units.failure: 錯把新孔測試結果覆蓋舊孔會形成虛假的驗收證據。設備改名卻未更新控制畫面會引導人員隔離錯誤回路，材料批次缺漏則使同批缺陷無法追蹤到其他位置。~Overwriting old-bore records with new-bore tests creates false acceptance evidence. Renaming an asset without updating the screen can isolate the wrong circuit; missing material batches prevent tracing related defects at other locations.
units.misconception: 全部檔案上傳完成就代表工程交接已經驗收合格。~Uploading all files means that engineering handover has been accepted.
units.practice: 本案「資產資料完整度」的交付需回答：抽查同名設備是否有唯一孔別、位置和維護週期。交接以可完成的定位、查找與復原任務驗證，由維護責任人確認現場可用性；完整度只是資料指標，不代表結構安全或設備可靠。~For Frejus Road Tunnel, the asset-record completeness handover must address the following evidence: Check similarly named assets have unique bore, location and maintenance interval. Validate handover through achievable location, retrieval and recovery tasks witnessed by maintainers; completeness measures records, not structural safety or equipment reliability.

example: 原創綜合審查：先計算「破碎帶連通與預報更新」，再獨立計算「通風網路與壓力損失」。原創教學假設：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s；水力坡降=2.1 無因次；通水面積=340 m²。Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s。僅把滲透係數增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為0.003927 m³/s。邊界：均質飽和達西流，不代表裂隙集中流；不是本工程實測或允收值。原創教學假設：達西因子=0.025 無因次；風道長度=1060 m；水力直徑=4 m；空氣密度=1.2 kg/m³；平均風速=3.5 m/s。Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.6937 Pa。僅把平均風速增加10%，其他條件不變，重算為58.9194 Pa。邊界：定密度直管摩阻，局部損失及外風另計；不是本工程實測或允收值。兩組結果的單位與邊界不同，不能直接相加。請列出一項缺少的現場輸入，說明它會影響哪個結論，以及哪種獨立量測可以縮小不確定度。~Original integrated review: first calculate fault connectivity and forecast updating, then independently calculate ventilation network and pressure loss. Original teaching assumptions: conductivity=5e-06 m/s; hydraulic gradient=2.1 dimensionless; flow area=340 m². Q=k i A=0.00357 m³/s. Increasing only conductivity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 0.003927 m³/s. Boundary: Homogeneous saturated Darcy flow, not concentrated fracture flow. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. Original teaching assumptions: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless; duct length=1060 m; hydraulic diameter=4 m; air density=1.2 kg/m³; mean velocity=3.5 m/s. Δp=f(L/D)ρv²/2=48.6937 Pa. Increasing only mean velocity by 10% with all other inputs fixed gives 58.9194 Pa. Boundary: Constant-density straight-duct friction; local loss and external wind are separate. These are not project measurements or acceptance values. The outputs have different units and boundaries and cannot simply be added. Identify one missing field input, explain which conclusion it changes and select an independent measurement to reduce uncertainty.
history: 1980 年公開記錄：弗雷瑞斯原公路隧道開始服務。法國交通主管機關列弗雷瑞斯原隧道12.87公里、1980年營運，並於2025年公告第二孔開通活動。本課不把原始單孔狀態當成永久現況，而以新舊孔轉換為主軸，研究重車交通、岩體、通風隔離、跨孔救援與設備版本，建立分階段可驗證的營運模型。本課把「新舊孔切換、重車服務與維護隔離」視為互相連動的系統，工程年代和名稱由所列公開來源核對；模型中的設備配置、荷載與量測數字另外標明為教學假設，只重建公開原理及工程推理，不是原始設計文件。~Public record for 1980: The original Frejus Road Tunnel enters service. The French transport ministry records the original Frejus tunnel as 12.87 km, in service from 1980, and announced the second-tube opening event in 2025. The course does not treat the original single-bore arrangement as permanent. It studies staged transfer, freight traffic, rock behaviour, airflow isolation, cross-bore rescue and equipment revisions. The course treats old-new bore transfer, freight service and maintenance isolation as coupled engineering questions. Named events and dimensions follow the listed public sources; equipment scenarios, loads and measurement values are separately marked teaching assumptions. Only public principles and reasoning are reconstructed, not original design documents.
facts: 公開工程尺度約為 12.87 km original tunnel，保留所列來源的計量邊界。~The public scale is about 12.87 km original tunnel; retain the measurement boundary in the cited source.
1980 年事件：弗雷瑞斯原公路隧道開始服務。~1980 event: The original Frejus Road Tunnel enters service.

教學「路線里程與端點」：長度=17.6 km，其餘輸入依單元，結果=17.6 min；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching alignment chainage and endpoints: length=17.6 km, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 17.6 min; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「破碎帶連通性」：滲透係數=5e-06 m/s，其餘輸入依單元，結果=0.00357 m³/s；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching fault-zone connectivity: conductivity=5e-06 m/s, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 0.00357 m³/s; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「襯砌環向壓縮」：均勻外壓=0.58 MPa，其餘輸入依單元，結果=5.63429 MPa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching lining hoop compression: uniform external pressure=0.58 MPa, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 5.63429 MPa; not measured or accepted project data.

教學「風道摩擦壓損」：達西因子=0.025 無因次，其餘輸入依單元，結果=48.6937 Pa；不是實測或允收值。~Teaching duct friction loss: Darcy factor=0.025 dimensionless, with remaining inputs as in the unit, gives 48.6937 Pa; not measured or accepted project data.
